Maria Chen: Quick follow-up from today's security Q&A — dropping a few targeted questions leadership asked about SOC2/ISO evidence and log custody.
Sanjay Patel: Who is the primary owner for customer audit requests that ask for chain-of-custody on logs? We need a single pager for SOC2 auditors.
Alex Rivera: Suggest Security own the evidence package, EngOps owns the export mechanism. We should document timelines (how long to produce raw logs vs redacted exports).
Jess Liu: For ISO, auditors often want supplier attestations. Do we plan to provide vendor questionnaires or just summary letters?
Priya Rao: Privacy flag: redaction rules must be explicit — sample export must include PII masking rules and an approver flow for EU customers.
Maria Chen: Actionable asks from leadership: 1) a 1-page SOC2 evidence workflow (owner, SLAs, handoffs); 2) sample audit export with redaction exemplar; 3) chain-of-custody statement template. Who can take these?
Sanjay Patel: I'll draft the SOC2 evidence workflow and proposed SLA (48h for standard evidence, 8h for enterprise emergency with approvals).
Alex Rivera: I'll produce a sample JSONL export and a short notes doc explaining what fields are redacted or reversible with access controls.
Jess Liu: I'll prepare vendor questionnaire templates and map supplier evidence we can reuse for ISO.
Priya Rao: I'll write the PII redaction rules and the privacy approval checklist for exports.
legal-bot: Reminder: legal review required for chain-of-custody language and cross-border export commitments. Please file a legal review ticket once drafts exist.
engops-bot: Note: evidence-export branch merged to staging at 2390012380 — basic export smoke test passed.
Maria Chen: Great. Please post links to drafts in this thread when ready. We want a short sales-facing FAQ too: what to tell customers now vs subject to legal signoff.
Alex Rivera: Will add a FAQ stub to the docs repo and mark any items that need legal sign-off.
Sanjay Patel: Scheduling a 30-min sync for evidence workflow next Tue — invite going out.
Maria Chen: Thanks all. Keep updates here and escalate blockers to me directly. :thumbsup:
